RetryClass.description: How the caller should treat a failure.

oneOf.description: A transient failure. The operation may be retried with backoff.
A permanent failure. Retrying the same operation cannot succeed.
Progress requires a person: missing credentials, an unanswered question, or a policy decision only the user can make.

ValidationCode.description: The stable reason a value was rejected.

oneOf.description: A required value was absent or blank.
A value exceeded its contract limit.
A collection had more items than its contract limit.
A collection had fewer items than the contract requires.
A value was outside the set the contract allows.
A value repeated where the contract requires uniqueness.
A referenced entity does not exist.
A required question has not been answered.
The schema version is not one this build understands.
The value carried provider or transport markup that must never reach a destination.

ValidationIssue.description: One thing wrong with a contract value.

code.description: A stable code callers may branch on, for example `empty` or `too_long`.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, for example `acceptance_criteria[0]`. Empty when the issue is about the value as a whole.

message.description: A sentence a person can act on.

description: The body of any failed API response.

code.description: The stable machine-readable code, for example `invalid_request`.

issues.description: Per-field detail, when the failure was contract validation.

retry_class.description: Whether repeating the request could help.
